blocks.etymology: From vaccinia, a cowpox infection. Ultimately from Latin vacca (“cow”). Coined by Edward Jenner (1749-1823) in 1798. It is now known that vaccinia and cow pox are separate conditions, but at the time of Jenner, they were considered the same condition.
